dari: Quick note — we rolled the opportunistic-kernel-switch canary this morning. TL;DR: p50 ~0, p95 -13%, p99 -30%, token-cost -12% on gpt-medium-ops. :tada:

dari: What it does: the runtime now switches to a faster int8 decode kernel mid-sequence when per-step entropy falls below a threshold for 5 consecutive tokens. It reverts to fp16 on KL spikes. Tiny proxy change also trims redundant system echoes.

lucy: Bench summary?

dari: Canary run (1% replay + synth):
```
baseline: p50 38ms p95 150ms p99 460ms cost=1.00
canary : p50 38ms p95 131ms p99 322ms cost=0.88
```

samir: Nice tail drop. Any quality hits in evals/human checks?

dari: Automated evals (12k prompts) + 200 human blind pairs: no meaningful delta. We added min_decodes=5 for short replies and a strict opt-out header for critical tool flows.

lucy: Infra notes? driver/compat issues?

dari: Gate int8 switch on driver >= 535.x and CUDA patchlevel checks. Saw a small spike in microbatch variance during warmup — tuned the batcher hysteresis to smooth it. No OOMs.

ops-bot: deploy: opportunistic-kernel-switch/v1 -> canary on pool-gpu-f (2 instances) at 2026-05-14T07:11:00Z

samir: Rollout plan + ops commands?

dari: Rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 72h with rollback if p99 or eval regressions exceed thresholds. Feature flags: runtime.opportunistic_kernel.enabled (canary=true), runtime.opportunistic_kernel.min_entropy, runtime.opportunistic_kernel.driver_min. Ops commands:
```
redwood deploy set-tag --pool pool-gpu-f --tag opportunistic-kernel-switch/v1 --pct 1
sleep 3600
redwood deploy set-tag --pool pool-gpu-f --tag opportunistic-kernel-switch/v1 --pct 5
```

lucy: Upload eval artifacts to s3 and add console tiles for "int8 switch rate" and "avg decode entropy".

dari: Done: s3://ci-redwood/benchmarks/opportunistic-kernel-switch/v1. Dedicated opt-in only; product to coordinate. Will post progress here as we ramp.
